  • TSpecGen, TCudaForge: each run's time under the chosen termination criterion (E likewise, in equivalent tokens); both runs are cut at T or E
  • Equivalent tokens E = xhit50 + xmiss + 4y (xhit, xmiss: cache-hit and cache-miss input; y: output); M = 106
  • GPU utilization = time with jobs runningtime (profiler: benchmark, ncu; validator: validation)
  • Iterations N+: N finished, stopped during the next one
  • ▲ / ▼: SpecGen's final best above / below CudaForge's (hover for the ratio)
  • Estimate = the actual timeline cut where the criterion would have ended each iteration; stop on reaching CudaForge's final best: CudaForge in full
  • CudaForge = SpecGen's baseline mode (one kernel per iteration, no spec, no early termination); both runs use the same GPUs and CPUs
